Class RouteSettings

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.RouteSettings
@Internal public final class RouteSettings extends Object
The settings of a route to a handler, recorded while the route is declared, see HttpRouteSpec: the route info is built from them when the router takes the route, and a declared route, whose route is created when the router first uses it, is created with them. Each setting is one field and one setter here; the route reads it when its route info is built.

The annotations, the annotated element and the response type are settings of the handler: given to the handler at once when the route has one, and recorded until the route is created otherwise, see applyTo(HandlerMethod). The port is exposed when it is set: the server opens the exposed ports before the routes are built.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
